observation.visible_scene: Nighttime waterfront city skyline seen across a calm river. Illuminated high-rises line the shore, dominated by a central tower topped with a glowing golden crown, plus a yellow-lit building on the right and streetlights along the embankment. Fireworks bursts explode in the sky around the central tower, and their lights, the building lights, and the smoke trails are mirrored as elongated, rippling reflections on the water.
visible_changes: t=0.00-0.07: several mid-expansion bursts (purple/white sparks with red and gold centers) sit around the central tower, with faint upward smoke trails.
t=0.13: a single very bright white flash blooms at right-center, throwing wide fan-shaped smoke trails; the water reflection of this flash is the brightest of the clip.
t=0.20-0.60: the flash decays into a dense starburst of white and purple sparks spreading outward and beginning to droop.
t=0.67-1.20: the sparks stretch into long falling 'willow' trails that descend toward the skyline and thin out.
t=1.27-2.00: falling sparks dim and nearly vanish; mainly gray smoke trails remain, with small bright bursts igniting low near the tower bases.
t=2.07-2.67: smoke lingers and drifts upward; occasional small orange/purple bursts reappear low by the central tower (frames 38-41).

Water reflections track these brightness and color changes continuously, distorted by ripples; the reflection column under the central tower shifts hue from white/purple to dim gold as the bursts fade.
A red beacon light on a left-side building becomes visible from t=0.67 onward (blinking), whereas earlier frames show it dark.
outside_clip_unknowns: What launched the fireworks and the full sequence before/after this excerpt.
Whether the bursts at the start were already mid-flight (onset not shown).
Final dissipation of the smoke and any later bursts beyond t=2.67.
uncertain_details: Camera appears static (skyline positions unchanged), but a slight framing/exposure difference around the bright flash at t=0.13 could be a brief camera adjustment or auto-exposure reaction rather than physical motion.
Distinguishing true smoke drift from ripple-induced wobble in the reflections is not possible from these frames.
The red beacon's on/off pattern is sampled too sparsely to confirm it is blinking versus steady.
